set.body:
Recovery experiment and partial repair — 2026-10-07

Independent nine-start dense/QR reference on 16 matched B0 voxels at noise ratios 0, 0.1, 0.5, 1, 2 proves noiseless recovery and separates search defects from weak-signal behavior. Source/evidence: docs/verification/phrf-recovery-20261007/README.md, branch work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007 based on ff4dd39f. All 80 reference energies agree with the portable banded objective. This is prepared-basis, condition-constant trial signal evidence, not original-family or random-effects calibration.

Retained opt-in DecodeInitialization.ChartCenterProbe charges one full jet/candidate when available and better under the data-plus-prior criterion. Default BankNode and default numerical budgets remain unchanged; provenance is explicitly decode-budget/v2 for both policies. With the same diagnostic 16-step/20-jet/40-exact/12-attempt budget and 1e-6 stationarity tolerance, eight-node bank-only accepts 0/16 at every noise level; center probe accepts 16,15,15,8,2. The independent reference has 16,16,15,10,3 interior stationary positive-curvature solutions and 0,0,1,6,13 boundary-preferred solutions. These budgets are not an accepted frozen B0 amendment.

Remaining concrete search failures: ratio 0.1 voxel 10 refuses curvature despite an interior reference solution (energy 1.8835732663 vs 1.7900486410). Ratio 1 voxel 3 is locally Accepted at a worse minimum than the boundary reference (3.9292657532 vs 3.9263841234; shape difference 0.3364 chart widths). Local Accepted does not establish best-solution selection. More bank nodes, nine interior probes and curvature-guarded backtracking did not resolve the strong-signal counterexample; the latter two were removed from production and archived as rejected experiments.

Validation: full fitJVM 689/689, full fitJS 632/632; 15 recovery/public-readout/workflow tests on each platform; packet verifies 53 source/artifact hashes, exact archived inputs and all 80 reference/candidate records. All 16 noiseless public outputs are off-node and consumed with Float32 conversion in the shared test. Receipts retain refused attempts and charged work. Small diagnostic execution times are not qualifying throughput.

Next bounded work: repair refinement and selection against the two concrete counterexamples while preserving budgets/terminal semantics (generic optimization belongs in Gale); specify weak/boundary scientific behavior; complete bounded N=1200 lowering and PHRF-11 original-equation evidence; only then execute full B0/stress performance gates and make the PHRF-33 activation/engineering decision. PHRF-33 remains OPEN/NOT ADMITTED. PHRF-14/15/16 remain open; finite-state work remains deferred. No acceptance criterion is relaxed.

---

Previous checkpoint and retained acceptance:

Current measured assessment — 2026-10-07

Public decoded diagnostic implemented and tested on JVM and JS, with independent augmented-QR output oracle and attempted/refused denominator. Source/receipts: docs/verification/phrf-checkpoint-20261007/README.md, branch work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007 based on 9ba2c57f (hosted Gale d03eb99b). PHRF-33 remains NOT ADMITTED and open; no full B0/performance/scientific pass or finite-state activation.

Measured blockers: dense basis compiler refuses 2,727,270 training cells above 2,000,000. Explicit BlockedPartial(96) admits unchanged rank 10/tolerance/domain. Under frozen eight-node bank/two-jet baseline, exact and corrected modes emit 0/256: 93 budget and 163 curvature refusals. Expanded six-step/eight-jet budget still emits 0/256; an explicit 27-node bank plus that budget emits 5/256. N=1,200 lowering refuses 7,200,000 convolved-term cells above 4,000,004. Original-equation evidence still refuses before reads. Current small samples are diagnostic, not throughput qualification; phase timing/memory/full denominators remain incomplete.

Next bounded work: resolve shape initialization/refinement admission against a dense same-model oracle before throughput tuning, preserve terminal/refusal semantics; make stress-case lowering bounded; integrate PHRF-11 original-equation evidence; then run full frozen checkpoint and make the activation/engineering decision. Old discarded-jet/fixed-truth component timings no longer say the complete gate passed. Do not treat a larger grid/budget as an accepted freeze change.

---

Earlier assessment and retained acceptance:

Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: Current decoded native ML/readout path is available and now charges stable-energy work and worker scratch. No complete frozen B0 profile/readout/certification checkpoint was run during consolidation; old discarded-jet/fixed-truth timings remain components.

Fresh context: Yes: complete workload decision.

Next action: Measure the actual current public path and all attempted work on the unchanged B0/stress schedule. Make a documented pass or activation/engineering decision; do not activate finite-state from an open ticket or old microbenchmark.

Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-pilot-integration-20261004.md; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md; original PHRF-33 workload criteria.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Owner: fit/profile integration benchmark and qualification receipt. Required P1 successor for the incomplete PHRF-07 checkpoint. Depends on PHRF-11 public decoded readout, PHRF-21 requalified shared condition/decoder contract, and PHRF-32 trial laws; PHRF-29 is reached through PHRF-11. This checkpoint precedes the full PHRF-14/15 qualification, so it cannot depend on those later results.

Problem:
TrialBandedBenchmark.scala:240 computes two jets then discards them. CompletePrepared reads the best bank node; CompleteExact reads the fixed generating coordinates from setup. ShapeDecoder, continuous refinement and final equation/basis/readout certification are absent. Existing 30.422/48.198-second timings remain valid component receipts, but not a complete profile+readout+certification pass.

Acceptance:
1. Define an executable measurement through the actual public PHRF-29/11 path: response acquisition/whitening/projection, declared criterion/prior scan, bounded continuous decoding, verified terminal curvature/admission, readout at THAT returned theta, equation/approximation certification, normalization/query/Float32 conversion and sink delivery. Include every attempted voxel, refusal and fallback. No hard-coded truth coordinates or discarded jets may stand in for selection.
2. Preserve frozen B0: T=600,N=300,C=3,F=6,V=100000,d=3, default Cascade34 family/chart/horizon and admitted basis, lambda=1, shared AR(1)=0.3, seeded dense schedule, eight-factor bank/eight-worker/256-block declared configuration and 120MB Float32 trial-output workload. Report the exact existing reference-host specification and revisions. Do not change the domain/rank/error tolerance to satisfy speed. Any necessary budget/configuration change is an explicit old/new decision with numerical consequences, not silent drift.
3. Report all node/continuous/value/jet/factor/solve/RHS counts, rejected attempts, terminal verification and approximate/exact-readout work. TrialBanded jetAt/energyAt currently build fresh factors off-node; measure that cost or implement an explicitly admitted bounded alternative before claiming the original budget. One amplitude correction and certification work remain explicit. Avoid hidden per-voxel covariance preparation.
4. Fill fixed-shape, one-reference, complete prepared/corrected and opt-in exact decoded readout cells on identical data/output work. Use <=120s complete B0 and <=256MiB engine live memory, plus <=12x one-reference and <=24x two-reference ratios to the appropriate exact fixed-shape denominator. Timing phases must expose input generation/acquisition, whitening, geometry/certificate preparation, projection, selection, readout and IO separately and in complete totals; excluded IO is still reported. Setup cannot silently remove a required phase.
5. Run dense and regular schedules at N=300 plus the declared N=1200,V=10000 stress/scaling case, with measured bandwidth and conservative preparation/runtime live-state bounds across all workers. Do not infer N=1200,V=100000 qualification. Keep primitive-array bounds, allocation/GC and whole-process RSS separate.
6. An independent small same-model oracle at decoded off-node shapes must verify outputs/criterion/terminal diagnostics before performance numbers are eligible. This is computational admission only; full scientific recovery/coverage remains PHRF-14. Record warmup and raw complete-cell receipts; PHRF-15 later owns >=5-run distributions and broader scaling.
7. Replace/extend the benchmark runner so it fails or clearly marks the receipt non-admitted on incomplete work, nonfinite results, budget exhaustion or accuracy failure. Update profile-hrf-trial-banded-evidence.md, profile-hrf-cohorts.md and the v2 completion paragraph to distinguish old component timings from the new complete checkpoint. Keep raw logs, environment, exact source/provider revisions and achieved/unmet goals.
8. Close with a measured DECISION, even if the budget fails: passing complete B0 keeps PHRF-10 deferred; a miss requires a documented activation/engineering disposition. If it activates PHRF-10, set it active/P1, promote its required PHRF-30 prerequisite and add blocking edges into qualification/release before closing this decision ticket. An unmet checkpoint is not a passing qualification and PHRF-15/16 cannot close on it. No finite-state implementation is automatically required just because the earlier receipt was incomplete.

Validation: affected benchmark compiles warning-clean, integrated correctness/lifecycle laws pass on JVM and JS, complete JVM B0 receipts exist for the exact measured configuration, and the final dependency graph matches the measured decision.
